name: dbos-step
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure dbos (release 068). Faults sit between the DBOS step and the plant, as for Temporal: the app on VM-A reaches the plant through the fault proxy on VM-C:28211. The step has a 2 s HTTP timeout per attempt and 3 attempts; late_factor 0.5 * 8 s = 4 s > 2 s. Measured locally against DBOS 3.3.0 + PostgreSQL 16 before release: K0, D_h and Q_A contradicted (P2: 3 effects, workflow ERROR).
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
